tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text from one language to another using LibreTranslate. Use for questions like 'translate hello to Spanish' or 'what does this say in English: bonjour le monde'.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the language of a given text. Use for questions like 'what language is this written in'.

tools.name: list_languages
